QUOTE: Calls `setChannelDeleteAt(now)`, so the archived channel stays in the local DB | Calls `removeCurrentUserFromChannel`, so the channel is dropped locally

The archiveChannel row says the channel is kept with `delete_at` set when viewable and `removeCurrentUserFromChannel` is called when `'false'`. The websocket row says the user is kicked via `handleKickFromChannel` if it is the current channel and removed locally. The answer never says "marked deleted" in those words, but "setChannelDeleteAt" and "stamps delete_at" cover it.

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both branches: non-viewable removes the user (and kicks if current channel), viewable keeps the channel with delete_at set.
